from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,shutil,time,sys
R=Path.cwd();D=R/'.cache/v193-git-storage-maintenance-v1';sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
from phase_admission_protocol import ref

def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=R)
def objects():return b'\n'.join(sorted(git('cat-file','--batch-all-objects','--batch-check=%(objectname)').splitlines()))+b'\n'
def logs():return {str(p.relative_to(R/'.git')):ref(p)['sha256']for p in (R/'.git/logs').rglob('*')if p.is_file()}
def save(name,v):
 with(D/name).open('x')as f:json.dump(v,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
old=objects();names=D/'all-objects-before.txt';names.write_bytes(old)
before={'status':'prospective-nonpruning-Git-storage-compaction','created_unix_UTC':time.time(),'HEAD':git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip(),'objects':len(old.splitlines()),'all_object_names_sha256':hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),'all_objects_before':ref(names),'references':git('show-ref').decode(),'index_sha256':ref(R/'.git/index')['sha256'],'reflogs':logs(),'free_before':shutil.disk_usage(R).free,'command':['git','-c','gc.reflogExpire=never','-c','gc.reflogExpireUnreachable=never','gc','--prune=never'],'source':dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'scope':'Physical Git packing only; retain all reachable/unreachable objects,refs,HEAD,index,reflog bytes. No source,photo,checkpoint,prediction,PNG or experiment-receipt change. All scientific workers are terminal. Temporary Git packing fits existing40GiB free; no neural forward until prospective resource floors again hold.'}
save('before-v1.json',before)
with(D/'gc-v1.log').open('xb')as log:subprocess.run(before['command'],cwd=R,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
new=objects();assert new==old
assert before['HEAD']==git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip() and before['references']==git('show-ref').decode() and before['index_sha256']==ref(R/'.git/index')['sha256'] and before['reflogs']==logs()
with(D/'fsck-v1.log').open('xb')as log:subprocess.run(['git','fsck','--full','--no-reflogs'],cwd=R,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
after=dict(before,status='pass-nonpruning-Git-compaction-all-objects-refs-index-HEAD-reflogs-preserved',free_after=shutil.disk_usage(R).free,fsck=ref(D/'fsck-v1.log'),gc_log=ref(D/'gc-v1.log'),before=ref(D/'before-v1.json'))
save('after-v1.json',after)
with(R/'docs/results/v193-git-storage-maintenance-v1.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(after,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('PASS all',before['objects'],'objects/refs/HEAD/index/reflogs preserved; freeGiB',after['free_after']/2**30,'reclaimedMiB',(after['free_after']-before['free_before'])/2**20,flush=True)
